review_type: read-only full static source/contract review; no candidate execution, focused checks, CAD, solver, or triangulation
decision: NO_STATIC_BLOCKER_AFTER_PIN_CORRECTION; single root-authorized run only within the external hard 120-second and separate artifact-tree caps; no physical or quality qualification implied

resolved_prior_blocker.effect: The prior extra-character pin no longer forces CandidateUnknown at the pre-generation audit comparison.

findings.cap_identity: candidate.py:251-298, 389-410 selects and maps exactly 128 z=0/R20 exterior faces and 128 z=2/R17 floor faces; center/boundary identity and winding are checked. focused_checks.py:284-318 independently identifies the physical caps.
findings.boundary_and_triangulation: candidate.py:150-180, 337-375 retains center and exact 128-vertex cap boundary, uses a fixed 1 mm triangular lattice with 0.4 mm margin and separate SciPy Delaunay calls. Frozen preflight metadata gives 2394 new vertices and 41876 predicted total faces; not recomputed here.
findings.preservation_and_budgets: candidate.py:389-421, 462-476, 588-607 preserves only the two cap modifications and checks noncap/connectivity/color preservation. candidate.py:535-583, 656-664 guards 128 parents, 15000 patch records, 60000 patch vertices and total vertex/face budgets before NPZ save.
findings.schema_and_lineage: candidate.py:596-615 omits standard v1 aliases; v2 cross-parent faces carry -1/NaN single-parent sentinel and complete CSR. focused_checks.py:321-427, 430-455, 497-511 reads CSR, vertex/face lineage, coverage, overlap, preservation, and quarantine.
findings.continuous_fields_and_colors: The patterned baseline outer color table remains bitwise preserved; focused_checks.py:212-280 uses periodic theta unwrapping and finite corner/edge-midpoint/centroid probes; planar cap field uses frozen constant base RGB with stored samples/sRGB checks at focused_checks.py:577-599. Finite samples do not prove a continuous field globally.
findings.quality_and_topology: focused_checks.py:153-209, 627-668 checks closed oriented one-component Euler-2 positive-volume geometry and relief-triangle Q/aspect for all faces, cap targets, unchanged noncap extrema, plus >64 scaled float64-epsilon global gains. These are geometry checks, not mechanics or solver qualification.
findings.output_evidence: candidate.py:704-709 writes checks.json before render; candidate_manifest.json follows successful rendering. A render failure can leave checks without manifest. run_candidate_once.py:45-48 limits retained child logs to 20 MiB; its child deadline/cleanup does not hard-bound its own snapshot/receipt tail, so the separately supplied external 120s hard timeout and artifact-tree cap are necessary.

execution.approved_execution: parent authorized a single actual run outside this review; independent saved-NPZ review is pending results and must not run if the execution stage fails

limitations: Static review cannot confirm actual triangulation, saved NPZ integrity, global quality, closure, or render correspondence.
Prewrite counts are read as frozen metadata, not independently recalculated.
The cap color/outer field probes are finite checks.
